card.name: The digit 3 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The single digit 3 written as the second digit of a multi-digit number, such as 23 or 13, usually in dose amounts and tables. It also appears in long numeric strings.

modes.label: Digit 3 in dose amounts
modes.description: The 3 follows a leading digit in a dose or volume figure before mg or mL.
modes.example: Recommended starting dosage is 3.75 mg/2<<3>> mg (phentermine mg/topiram

modes.label: Digit 3 in tables and strings
modes.description: The 3 sits inside a number in a table row or a long numeric ID.

card.plain: It lights up on the digit 3 when it is the second digit of a number like 13 or 23.
